## Foods & dishes

- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 2 dishes (1 Angola-only: calulú de carne seca with funge; Portuguese); free-text ingredients, no amounts or method, plus eating context (time of day, occasion, utensils, local-language name).
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 13 recipes (no amounts, steps, nutrition); [[RecipeDB2]]: 12 (v1, not released).

## Ingredients & food composition
